question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Tesla)

calls.reasoning: Anchor: Q2 2026 revenue $28.24B on 480,126 deliveries and 13.5 GWh storage (auto $20.52B, energy $3.14B). Q3 deliveries 486,532 (+1.3% QoQ, ~5% above consensus) and storage 13.7 GWh imply ~$28.4-28.8B with flat per-vehicle revenue. Analyst consensus is $27.6-28.1B, possibly stale relative to the delivery beat; Tesla beat the Q2 revenue consensus by ~10%. Headwinds: weak US/China August sales and mix, regulatory credits collapsing, pricing pressure. Tailwinds: FX, services/FSD growth. No revenue market found on Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi (Kalshi had a deliveries market only).

- Q2 2026: revenue $28.24B (record, +26% YoY), deliveries 480,126, storage 13.5 GWh; automotive revenue $20.52B; energy $3.14B; regulatory credits $146M (down 67% YoY); revenue consensus had been $25.71B (Yahoo/Electrek, 2026-07-22).
- Q3 2025: revenue $28.10B on 497,099 deliveries, 12.5 GWh (US tax-credit pull-forward quarter).
- Last 8 quarterly revenues ($M): 25,182; 25,707; 19,335; 22,496; 28,095; 24,901; 22,387; 28,236.
- Q3 2026 revenue consensus: $27.92B (MarketBeat), $27.8B (Zacks), $27.79B (Mint, 2026-10-17), $28.11B (24 analysts), $27.6B (Hudson Labs). EPS consensus ~$0.44-0.45.
- Negatives: August US sales -26% YoY (~40.8k), China retail -12.4% (~50k); regulatory credits shrinking; Q2 gross margin 16.8%; reports of pricing pressure.
- Positives: delivered 22k more than produced (inventory drawdown); FSD paid users 1.48M (+56% YoY); services/other ~$4.6B in Q2 and growing.
- Resolves off Tesla's Q3 2026 8-K/shareholder deck total revenues as first reported, scheduled for Oct 21, 2026 after close.
- Event window: quarter Jul 1 -> Sep 30, 2026 (complete); report due Oct 21; as of Oct 17 the quarter is 100% elapsed and only the reported number is unknown.
- Searched for but did not find: a Kalshi/Polymarket market on revenue (found only a Kalshi deliveries market); Q3 regional mix and ASP data.
calls.reference_class: Tesla quarterly revenue relative to the prior quarter's revenue per delivery, scaled by reported deliveries and storage (Q3 2025-Q2 2026)

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share identical facts (Q3 deliveries 486,532, storage 13.7 GWh, Q2 rev $28.24B with segment mix, consensus $27.6-28.1B). Disagreements are judgment only: median ($28.35-28.5B) and width ($1.8-2.4B). Noted that Zacks segment estimates sum (~$28.2B ex-leasing) exceed its own $27.79B total, suggesting its total is stale/inconsistent; cannot verify without web. Bottom-up scaling gives ~$28.7B; I shade for mix/discount headwinds to $28.45B and keep a ~$2.1B 10-90 width, with small open-bound tails.
